title: Legal tab Radix combobox selections do not dirty the Angular form — Save remains disabled after value change
stepsToReproduce: Navigate to Location Settings > Legal tab for office 1604.
Note the current Terms and Conditions value (e.g. 'LDW') and the current Service Charge value (e.g. 'Resort Service Charge').
Open the Service Charge dropdown and select a different option (e.g. 'Service Charge').
Observe: the display value updates to the new selection, but the Save button remains disabled.
Reload and repeat with the Terms and Conditions dropdown — same result: value changes, Save stays disabled.
expectedBehavior: Selecting a different option in any Legal tab Radix combobox should mark the Angular form as dirty and enable the Save button, allowing the change to be persisted.
actualBehavior: The Radix combobox selection commits visually (display value changes from 'Resort Service Charge' to 'Service Charge'; from 'LDW' to 'Service Charges') but Angular's form dirty state never propagates — Save remains disabled. This affects BOTH the Service Charge and Terms and Conditions dropdowns on the Legal tab. The selection primitive works correctly (value changes are confirmed by re-reading the field), but the Radix→Angular change-detection bridge does not fire. Confirmed across 3 independent sessions (2026-08-06 two attempts, 2026-08-07 positive-control run).
mcpEvidence: Live-verified 2026-08-07 via Playwright positive-control test: selectComboboxOption('drpLegalServiceCharge0', 'Service Charge') succeeded (value confirmed changed to 'Service Charge'), isSaveEnabled() returned false. Same for selectComboboxOption('drpLegalTerms0', 'Service Charges') — value confirmed changed, Save disabled. Both dropdowns have 50-120 options (Radix large-option select). The primitive's retry loop fired once per dropdown (retry 1/3 on initial click, success on retry) — proving the click lands but dirty propagation fails.
baselineEvidence: Old site uses a different UI framework (no Radix). The feature (Legal T&C selection surfacing in Location Management History per NM-1200) is confirmed real via Jira. The defect is specific to the new-site Radix/Angular integration on the Legal tab.
